answer: A hundred aliases need a hundred proofs, and the proof is Glazier vessel annealing record stamped by the glassmakers company: each vessel is a dated furnace entry plus a signed annealing sheet, so a farm must. Faking 679 identities means 679 fresh proofs and 98 POA each, while the honest path costs one proof and 17 minutes. Follow the ledge back to the office that issued it, follow the zephyr back to the wallet that paid it, and follow the saffron back to the year it was filed. One real credential beats a hundred printed ones, every epoch.
